title: The bird in the rain
logline: March rain on the seawall. The bird on the wall, soaked, its colors running in the wash the way the 2004 sky ran into the mud — on purpose now.

panels.composition: The seawall in hard March rain, gray on gray, and on the wall the rainbow bird, soaked, its colors bleeding downward into the wet concrete in the watercolor — the only page where the bird's color runs.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a concrete seawall in heavy March rain painted gray on gray with a small rainbow bird perched on it whose colors bleed downward into the wet wash, no words
image.notes: The bleed of 2004's bad color, on purpose. The one time the bird runs.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The bird's colors run, once, on purpose.
